exposure: use of balloons for cervical ripening
cohort: The study analyzed 2,037,460 deliveries from 942 institutions in Japan between 2007 and 2011, focusing on cases of umbilical cord prolapse during labor.
finding: The risk of fore-lying or prolapse of the umbilical cord during labor was significantly increased with the use of balloons for cervical ripening (Odds ratio 13.67, 95% confidence interval 10.21, 18.30).
